title: NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra
title_zh: Ghidra 软件逆向工程框架

paragraphs.en: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
paragraphs.zh: Ghidra 是一个软件逆向工程（SRE）框架

paragraphs.en: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework created and maintained by the National Security Agency Research Directorate. This framework includes a suite of full-featured, high-end software analysis tools that enable users to analyze compiled code on a variety of platforms including Windows, macOS, and Linux. Capabilities include disassembly, assembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting, along with hundreds of other features. Ghidra supports a wide variety of processor instruction sets and executable formats and can be run in both user-interactive and automated modes. Users may also develop their own Ghidra extension components and/or scripts using Java or Python.
paragraphs.zh: Ghidra 是由美国国家安全局研究部门创建并维护的软件逆向工程（SRE）框架。 该框架包含一整套功能齐全的高端软件分析工具，使用户能够分析包括 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 在内的多种平台上的已编译代码。 其功能包括反汇编、汇编、反编译、绘图和脚本编写，以及数百项其他特性。 Ghidra 支持多种处理器指令集和可执行文件格式，并可在用户交互模式和自动化模式下运行。 用户还可以使用 Java 或 Python 开发自己的 Ghidra 扩展组件和/或脚本。

paragraphs.en: In support of NSA's Cybersecurity mission, Ghidra was built to solve scaling and teaming problems on complex SRE efforts, and to provide a customizable and extensible SRE research platform. NSA has applied Ghidra SRE capabilities to a variety of problems that involve analyzing malicious code and generating deep insights for SRE analysts who seek a better understanding of potential vulnerabilities in networks and systems.
paragraphs.zh: 为支持美国国家安全局（NSA）的网络安全使命，Ghidra 的构建旨在解决复杂逆向工程（SRE）工作中的规模化和团队协作问题，并提供一个可定制、可扩展的 SRE 研究平台。 NSA 已将 Ghidra 的 SRE 能力应用于多种涉及分析恶意代码的问题，并为那些希望更深入理解网络和系统潜在漏洞的 SRE 分析师生成深刻的洞察。

paragraphs.en: If you are a U.S. citizen interested in projects like this, to develop Ghidra and other cybersecurity tools for NSA to help protect our nation and its allies, consider applying for a career with us .
paragraphs.zh: 如果您是一名对这类项目感兴趣的美国公民，希望为国家安全局（NSA）开发 Ghidra 及其他网络安全工具，以帮助保护我们的国家及其盟友，请考虑申请加入我们的职业队伍。

paragraphs.en: WARNING: There are known security vulnerabilities within certain versions of Ghidra. Before proceeding, please read through Ghidra's Security Advisories for a better understanding of how you might be impacted.

paragraphs.en: To install an official pre-built multi-platform Ghidra release:
paragraphs.zh: 要安装官方预构建的多平台 Ghidra 发行版：

paragraphs.en: For additional information and troubleshooting tips about installing and running a Ghidra release, please refer to the Getting Started document which can be found at the root of a Ghidra installation directory.
paragraphs.zh: 有关安装和运行 Ghidra 发行版的更多信息与故障排除提示，请参阅《入门指南》（Getting Started）文档，该文档位于 Ghidra 安装目录的根目录下。

paragraphs.en: To create the latest development build for your platform from this source repository:
paragraphs.zh: 要从该源代码仓库为你的平台创建最新的开发版本：

paragraphs.en: unzip ghidra-master cd ghidra-master NOTE: Instead of downloading the compressed source, you may instead want to clone the GitHub repository: git clone https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra.git
paragraphs.zh: unzip ghidra-master cd ghidra-master 注意：您也可以选择克隆 GitHub 仓库，而不是下载压缩源代码： git clone https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra.git

paragraphs.en: NOTE: If an Internet connection is available and you did not install Gradle, the ./gradlew (or gradlew.bat ) command may be used in place of the gradle command in the following instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：如果 Internet 连接可用且你尚未安装 Gradle，则在以下说明中可以使用 ./gradlew（或 gradlew.bat）命令代替 gradle 命令。

paragraphs.en: gradle -I gradle/support/fetchDependencies.gradle Create development build: gradle buildGhidra The compressed development build will be located at build/dist/ .
paragraphs.zh: gradle -I gradle/support/fetchDependencies.gradle 创建开发版本：gradle buildGhidra 压缩后的开发版本将位于 build/dist/ 目录中。

paragraphs.en: For more detailed information on building Ghidra, please read the Developer's Guide .
paragraphs.zh: 有关构建 Ghidra 的更详细信息，请阅读《开发者指南》（Developer's Guide）。

paragraphs.en: For issues building, please check the Known Issues section for possible solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 如遇构建问题，请查看“已知问题”章节以获取可能的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Ghidra installations support users writing custom scripts and extensions via the GhidraDev plugin for Eclipse. The plugin and its corresponding instructions can be found within a Ghidra release at Extensions/Eclipse/GhidraDev/ or at this link . Alternatively, Visual Studio Code may be used to edit scripts by clicking the Visual Studio Code icon in the Script Manager. Fully-featured Visual Studio Code projects can be created from a Ghidra CodeBrowser window at Tools -> Create VSCode Module project .
paragraphs.zh: Ghidra 安装通过面向 Eclipse 的 GhidraDev 插件，支持用户编写自定义脚本和扩展。 该插件及其对应说明可在 Ghidra 发行版的 Extensions/Eclipse/GhidraDev/ 目录中找到，或通过此链接获取。 另外，也可以通过在脚本管理器中点击 Visual Studio Code 图标，使用 Visual Studio Code 编辑脚本。 可以从 Ghidra 的 CodeBrowser 窗口通过 Tools -> Create VSCode Module project 创建功能完整的 Visual Studio Code 项目。

sents.en: Ghidra installations support users writing custom scripts and extensions via the GhidraDev plugin for Eclipse.
sents.zh: Ghidra 安装通过面向 Eclipse 的 GhidraDev 插件，支持用户编写自定义脚本和扩展。

sents.en: The plugin and its corresponding instructions can be found within a Ghidra release at Extensions/Eclipse/GhidraDev/ or at this link .
sents.zh: 该插件及其对应说明可在 Ghidra 发行版的 Extensions/Eclipse/GhidraDev/ 目录中找到，或通过此链接获取。

sents.en: Alternatively, Visual Studio Code may be used to edit scripts by clicking the Visual Studio Code icon in the Script Manager.
sents.zh: 另外，也可以通过在脚本管理器中点击 Visual Studio Code 图标，使用 Visual Studio Code 编辑脚本。

sents.en: Fully-featured Visual Studio Code projects can be created from a Ghidra CodeBrowser window at Tools -> Create VSCode Module project .
sents.zh: 可以从 Ghidra 的 CodeBrowser 窗口通过 Tools -> Create VSCode Module project 创建功能完整的 Visual Studio Code 项目。

paragraphs.en: NOTE: Both the GhidraDev plugin for Eclipse and Visual Studio Code integrations only support developing against fully built Ghidra installations which can be downloaded from the Releases page.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：Eclipse 的 GhidraDev 插件和 Visual Studio Code 集成仅支持针对完整构建的 Ghidra 安装进行开发，可从 Releases 页面下载这些安装包。

paragraphs.en: To develop the Ghidra tool itself, it is highly recommended to use Eclipse, which the Ghidra development process has been highly customized for.
paragraphs.zh: 要开发 Ghidra 工具本身，强烈建议使用 Eclipse，因为 Ghidra 的开发流程已针对其进行了高度定制。

paragraphs.en: gradle prepdev eclipse buildNatives Import Ghidra projects into Eclipse: File -> Import... General | Existing Projects into Workspace Select root directory to be your downloaded or cloned ghidra source repository Check Search for nested projects Click Finish When Eclipse finishes building the projects, Ghidra can be launched and debugged with the provided Ghidra Eclipse run configuration .
paragraphs.zh: gradle prepdev eclipse buildNatives 将 Ghidra 项目导入 Eclipse：File -> Import... General | Existing Projects into Workspace 将根目录选择为你下载或克隆的 ghidra 源码仓库 勾选 Search for nested projects 点击 Finish 当 Eclipse 完成项目构建后，即可使用提供的 Ghidra Eclipse 运行配置来启动和调试 Ghidra。

sents.en: gradle prepdev eclipse buildNatives Import Ghidra projects into Eclipse: File -> Import...
sents.zh: gradle prepdev eclipse buildNatives 将 Ghidra 项目导入 Eclipse：File -> Import...

sents.en: General | Existing Projects into Workspace Select root directory to be your downloaded or cloned ghidra source repository Check Search for nested projects Click Finish When Eclipse finishes building the projects, Ghidra can be launched and debugged with the provided Ghidra Eclipse run configuration .
sents.zh: General | Existing Projects into Workspace 将根目录选择为你下载或克隆的 ghidra 源码仓库 勾选 Search for nested projects 点击 Finish 当 Eclipse 完成项目构建后，即可使用提供的 Ghidra Eclipse 运行配置来启动和调试 Ghidra。

paragraphs.en: For more detailed information on developing Ghidra, please read the Developer's Guide .

paragraphs.en: If you would like to contribute bug fixes, improvements, and new features back to Ghidra, please take a look at our Contributor's Guide to see how you can participate in this open source project.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您愿意为 Ghidra 贡献错误修复、改进和新功能，请查阅我们的贡献者指南，了解如何参与这个开源项目。
